name: Harpy
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.
designRole: Madness pressure about an evil accusation can cause deaths if not followed.
explanation: Madness pressure about an evil accusation can cause deaths if not followed.
